items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Vaughn and Guitru, who were dancers.

ctx.x: You've got to sit down and go through it. You know I had a few more things. When you do an interview, you think you've got everything, and you know you don't have everything. Oh, but I wanted you to describe, we talked about a show at the Doudrop. And who were some of the people you worked with at the Doudrop?

Oh, I told you, one of them I can remember. Big Joe Tate on them, White Arnold Harris. Vaughn and Guitru, who were dancers. And a guy called Patsy Veldera. He was a homosexual. And he was the hottest thing at the, because he would come in and dress, dressed up in a dress, and high heel shoes. And sometimes I think he really thought, he believed that he was a woman. He was always the main attraction over there. Whether he was supposed to be the main attraction or nothing. Because he would act just like a woman…
Well how popular were the general transvestites and the gay reviews at the Doudrop?
